prompt:
A single compound was assayed by IC50 against a single protein target in two different assays, reported in the literature.

Compound SMILES: COc1ccc2c3c1O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O)C=C[C@@]31CCN(C)C2
Target (ChEMBL): CHEMBL220

Assay A:
  Description: Inhibition of AChE (unknown origin) using acetylthiocholine iodide as substrate preincubated for 15 mins followed by substrate addition by Ellman's method
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Assay B:
  Description: Inhibition of human acetylcholinesterase using ATCI/DTNB as substrate preincubated for 30 mins followed by substrate addition measured for 60 mins by Ellman method
  Assay type: B
  ChEMBL confidence score: 9
  Organism: Homo sapiens

Will the two reported IC50 values agree closely (within 0.3 log units), or differ substantially (more than 1.0 log units)?

Respond with exactly this JSON and nothing else:
{"call": "COMMENSURABLE" | "NOT_COMMENSURABLE" | "INSUFFICIENT_INFO",
 "confidence": <float 0-1>,
 "error_class": "assay_method" | "buffer_conditions" | "construct_mutant" | "organism" | "readout_type" | "potency_range" | "none" | "other",
 "reason": "<one sentence>"}

"COMMENSURABLE" means you expect the two reported values to agree closely.
"NOT_COMMENSURABLE" means you expect them to differ substantially.
error_class is your primary reason for a NOT_COMMENSURABLE call, else "none".
raw: {"call": "COMMENSURABLE", "confidence": 0.72, "error_class": "none", "reason": "Both assays measure IC50 of the same compound against human AChE using the same Ellman's method with the same substrate (ATCI), differing only in preincubation time (15 vs 30 mins), which for a reversible inhibitor like galanthamine is unlikely to cause >0.3 log unit differences."}

parsed.reason: Both assays measure IC50 of the same compound against human AChE using the same Ellman's method with the same substrate (ATCI), differing only in preincubation time (15 vs 30 mins), which for a reversible inhibitor like galanthamine is unlikely to cause >0.3 log unit differences.
